events.title: Community Choir: The Musical
events.description: Community Choir: The Musical is a heartwarming and hilarious tale written by Emma Dean, directed by Belinda Raisin, and performed almost entirely by local community members — many stepping on stage for the very first time.

events.title: Abode of Music Presents Panchabhoota – the 5 elements of nature
events.description: Svaraalaya – the Abode of Music presents Panchabhoota – the 5 elements of nature through music. This features a combination of group and solo singing, involving 80 vocalists. They will be supported by talented instrumentalists. The music presented will be South Indian Classical music.
